reason: Morning tiffin prep requires whatever is readily stocked in my fridge or delivered in 10 minutes from Zepto. I am not going to order chutney from a website and wait two or three days for a courier delivery when I can just grab a bottle from the kirana or whip up something in five minutes.
objection: D2C online courier delivery creates unacceptable friction and delay for an everyday pantry staple.
would_change_my_mind: Instant availability on Blinkit or Zepto so I can toss it into my regular weekly basket.
